# Verified Bounty Radar

> Public machine-readable verification for GitHub software-bounty opportunities.

Homepage: https://a40014859-gif.github.io/verified-bounty-radar/
Repository: https://github.com/a40014859-gif/verified-bounty-radar
Live JSON feed: https://a40014859-gif.github.io/verified-bounty-radar/feed.json

Agent instructions: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a40014859-gif/verified-bounty-radar/main/SKILL.md
CLI verifier: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a40014859-gif/verified-bounty-radar/main/verify.py

## Purpose

Use Radar before allocating coding-agent time to a public GitHub bounty. It checks evidence such as canonical issue state, assignees, claim signals, reward text, and open pull requests referencing the issue.

## Important limitations

An open issue or advertised reward is not proof of eligibility, acceptance, or payment. Program terms, legal eligibility, hardware requirements, and payment rails may require separate verification.
